publication: Dixit et al. 2016, Perturb-seq: Dissecting molecular circuits with scalable single-cell RNA profiling of pooled genetic screens, Cell
gene_selection_rule: Within the locked KEGG pathway, take the first N gene symbols by alphabetical order. Skip any gene not present in the dataset. The final list is fixed; no post-hoc additions or removals to improve scores.
notes: Selection was performed from the KEGG p53 signaling pathway gene list before inspecting the dataset.
Actual presence in GSE90063 and final n_nodes will be filled by perturb_seq_preprocessing.py without changing the rule or pathway.
If fewer than 10 of the 12 genes are present, the dataset is unsuitable and Stage 4 stops with honest negative.

diagnostic.protocol_criterion: >=5 CRISPR KO targets among the selected locked genes
